About the BikeAthens Joy Ride group ride

Slow in-town ride from the BikeAthens community shop. Six to eight miles on streets and multi-use paths with a ride leader up front and a sweeper in back. Nobody gets left. Optional hang at Athentic Brewing after.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
